Future locked in memories, drugs through veins.

记忆困锁未来，药物流入血管。

2239, worlds rewritten in sand,

灵魂被注视、审判与描绘。

Cameras in my eyes since seven years old,

七岁起双眼便装上镜头，

Behavior scored, my story controlled.

行为被打分，我的故事被操控。

They erase our minds, replay the pain,

记忆被抹去，痛苦不断重现，

Identity reshaped, rewired, retrained.

人格被改写、重塑、重连。

Cyber slaves trapped, dreams dissolved in tides,

赛博奴隶被困住，梦想溶入浪潮，

Mechanical island, no place to hide.

机械的孤岛，无处可逃。

Freedom drifting, left unclear,

自由渐行渐远，陷入迷惘，

Locked inside echoes—truth or fear?

困于回声之间，是真实或惶恐？

Injected with amnesia, personality reset,

注射失忆药剂，人格再设定，

Every treasured memory turned to threat.

珍贵回忆变成危险陷阱。

Servers analyze every breath, every crime,

服务器分析每次呼吸，每个罪行，

在钢铁囚牢、巨浪之前。

Faces I cherished, now fading away,

曾珍视的面孔逐渐模糊，

Replay the goodbyes every single day.

每日重演无尽的告别。

Boundaries blurred, familiar became unknown,

边界模糊，熟悉变成未知，

Yet they claimed, "This is how we've grown."

他们却低语：“我们如此成长。”

My memories streaming, captured and sold,

Freedom still echoes somewhere down the line.

自由的回声仍在远方响起。

Though tides erase traces, my heart beats clear,

纵然潮汐抹去了痕迹，我心依旧清晰，

No such island can silence my tear.

这岛也永无法让我沉默。

新纪2239，反乌托邦的命运，
